**Approach.** For each pair (s, u), the tangent line of x ↦ g1(s)^x·g2(s) at x = u lies below that curve, by convexity of exp. Every tangent line is therefore below the supremum, and at x = u it touches the curve. Indexing the tangent lines by ℝ × ℝ and transporting along a bijection ℝ ≃ ℝ × ℝ (from cardinality, 𝔠·𝔠 = 𝔠) gives the functions h1 and h2. The two suprema then agree by two inequalities, using a uniform upper bound B1^|x|·B2 to ensure both sets are bounded above.
